import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import lightgbm as lgb

# Disable progress bars
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_FPS"] = "0"
os.environ["LIGHTGBMverbosity"] = "0"

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from correct path
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.get("sample_submission.csv")

# Extract feature columns (all columns except id and species in train)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]

# Get species names from sample submission (skip first column which is id)
species_cols = [col for col in sample_submission.columns if col != "id"]

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df["species"].values.astype(str)

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values.astype(str)

# Create 80/20 hold-out validation split - this is crucial for genuine hold-out evaluation
X_train_final, X_val, y_train_final, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train LightGBM classifier with optimized parameters for faster training
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=50,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=5,
    num_leaves=15,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

# Train the model
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Evaluate on validation set (genuine hold-out evaluation - model was NOT trained on this)
val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe matching sample_submission format
submission = pd.DataFrame(index=test_ids.astype(str), columns=["id"] + species_cols)
submission["id"] = test_ids.astype(str)
for i, species in enumerate(species_cols):
    submission[species] = test_proba[:, i]

# Save submission file
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Expected columns: {len(sample_submission.columns)}")
